ns0:model.name: mango
ns0:model.description: The purpose of MANGO is to provide a higher level of description for multi-attribute properties. When used with MIVOT annotations, it enables tabular data to be represented as structured objects. This enables the metadata representation to be improved and complex quantities to be reconstructed from column values. Modelled properties can be linked to each other. MANGO also enables the origin of the data to be specified.
ns0:model.title: Mango
ns0:model.author: Laurent Michel, Fran??ois Bonnarel, Gilles Landais, Mireille Louys, Marco Molinaro, Jesue Salgado

primitiveType.name: DecimalYear
primitiveType.description: Fractional number of years AD represented by the date. 2000.0, or equivalently 1999.99recurring, is midnight at the start of the first of January 2000. Because of leap years, the size of a unit depends on what year it is in (see \url{https://www.star.bris.ac.uk/~mbt/topcat/sun253/sun253.html#Times}).

primitiveType.name: iso
primitiveType.description: Primitive type for observation dates expressed as an ISO-8601 Date (e.g. "2025-08-07T09:29:14").

primitiveType.name: mjd
primitiveType.description: Primitive type for observation dates expressed as a Modified Julian Date (e.g. 60288.8).

primitiveType.name: jd
primitiveType.description: Primitive type for observation dates expressed as a Julian Date (e.g. 2460895.1).

primitiveType.name: JulianEpoch
primitiveType.description: A continuous measure based on a Julian year of exactly 365.25 days ($JulianEpoch = 2000 + \frac{jd - 2451545.0}{365.25}$). For approximate purposes this resembles the fractional number of years AD represented by the date. Can be represented by prefixing a 'J'; J2000.0 is defined as 2000 January 1.5 in the TT timescale. (see \url{https://www.star.bris.ac.uk/~mbt/topcat/sun253/sun253.html#Times}).

primitiveType.name: BesselianEpoch
primitiveType.description: A continuous measure based on a tropical year of about 365.2422 days ($BesselianEpoch = 1900.0 + \frac{jd - 2415020.31352}{365.242198781}$). For approximate purposes this resembles the fractional number of years AD represented by the date. Can be represented by prefixing a 'B'. (see \url{https://www.star.bris.ac.uk/~mbt/topcat/sun253/sun253.html#Times}).

enumeration.name: FootprintSerialization
enumeration.description: Enumeration of the supported serialization modes for the footprints

literal.name: SMOC
literal.description: Label indicating that the footprint has been serialized as a SMOC \citep{2022ivoa.spec.0727F}. SMOC should be in equatorial ICRS. This overrides \texttt{mango:Footprint.spaceSys} reference which can be ignored when using this serialisation.

literal.name: STC-S
literal.description: Label indicating that the footprint has been serialized as a STC-S string (see \url{https://www.ivoa.net/documents/STC-S/20130917/index.html}). The STC-S space coordinate system overrides the \texttt{mango:Footprint.spaceSys} reference which can be ignored when using this serialisation. Although the STC-S standard has been an IVOA draft for many years, it is still used by certain services, which justifies MANGO's support for it.

literal.name: POLYGON
literal.description: Label indicating that the footprint has been serialized as a polygon as defined in \cite{2017ivoa.spec.0517D} section 3.3.7. Using the polygon serialization requires the space coordinate system to be defined.

enumeration.name: ColorDefinition
enumeration.description: Enumeration of the different types of colors supported by the model.

literal.name: HardnessRatio
literal.description: Normalized ratio of fluxes: $(F_{EB2} - F_{EB1}) / (F_{EB2} + F_{EB1})$

dataType.name: VocabularyTerm
dataType.description: Class holder for a term of a standardized vocabulary that applies to a property.

attribute.name: uri
attribute.description: URI of the vocabulary term

attribute.name: label
attribute.description: Label attached to the vocabulary term. This is necessary because the URI may not contain any explicit label. This was the case for the UAT vocabulary until the Registry WG introduced rewriting rules that fix the issue.

dataType.name: DateTime
dataType.description: Data type for timestamps and their representation. Timestamps are modeled by a single value and a representation mode. There is no time scale associated with \texttt{mango:DateTime}. The scale is either imposed by the representation mode or defined by the time coordinate system relevant for the host object, usually an instance of \texttt{mango:EpochPosition}.

attribute.name: representation
attribute.description: Define the representation mode. The supported values are \texttt{iso} or \texttt{dateformat} for ISO dates, \texttt{year}, \texttt{jd} or \texttt{mjd}. The list of supported values could be extended in the future with new endorsed \texttt{xtype} values.

attribute.name: dateTime
attribute.description: Data type for timestamps and their representation. Timestamps are modeled by a single value and a representation mode. There is no time scale associated with \texttt{mango:DateTime}. The scale is either imposed by the representation mode or defined by the time coordinate system relevant for the host object,

objectType.name: MangoObject
objectType.description: Central model class: applied to a data table, each row can be modelled as a \texttt{MangoObject} instance. Each \texttt{MangoObject} hosts a collection of physical or calculated parameters, a description of the data origin and an identifier.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.description: Unique identifier of the \texttt{MangoObject}. The uniqueness of that identifier is not managed by the model. The format is free.

composition.name: propertyDock
composition.description: Contains the open-ended collection of the \texttt{MangoObject} properties (physical, calculated or assigned).

composition.name: mangoObjects
composition.description: Collection of particular datasets (\texttt{mango:MangoObject} instances) that are associated with the MANGO object via \texttt{mango:AssociatedMangoObject} instances.

reference.name: queryOrigin
reference.description: Reference to the description of the origin of the dataset to which the \texttt{MangoObject} belongs.

objectType.name: DataLink
objectType.description: This property describes static links pointing to some external data. This allows services that do not implement DataLink services to expose linked data as flattened DataLink (1.1) responses.

attribute.name: content_type
attribute.description: Provides the mime type of the content the link returns (see DataLink 1.1)

attribute.name: access_url
attribute.description: Contains an URL for downloading a single resource. There is no restriction on the type of resource accessed by the links.

attribute.name: content_qualifier
attribute.description: Gives the nature of the thing or service that is returned by the link. The value is always interpreted as a URI. If the access_url references a data product, the content_qualifier field should define its product type . In this case the content qualifier value always starts with a hash completing the \url{http://www.ivoa.net/rdf/datalink/product-type} base URI. For \texttt{MangoObject} not linking to data products, content_qualifier’s interpretation will be different, and the default vocabulary will be inappropriate. Full concept URIs will have to be used in this case. (DataLink 1.1)

attribute.name: local_semantics
attribute.description: Allows for link identification where the combination of semantics, content_type and content_qualifier is not sufficient (see DataLink 1.1).

objectType.name: AssociatedMangoObject
objectType.description: This class gives the role of a link associating 2 \texttt{MangoObject} together.

attribute.name: semantics
attribute.description: Semantic concept giving the nature of the data association.

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: Free text description of the data association

objectType.name: Property
objectType.description: Class holder for a \textit{flavor} of property, i.e., there should be a Property subclass for each \textit{flavor} of Property being hosted. The property types are not limited to “physical or calculated” (eg: flags, assigned labels) This class specifies both type and role of the property, and hosts the property instance itself.

attribute.name: semantics
attribute.description:
Reference to a semantic concept giving the nature of the property or of the set made of the property and its associated properties (e.g. position and flag).
This attribute is intended to be machine-readable and to assist automated property presentation, and usage. The value is always interpreted as a URI; relative URIs are completed using the base URI of the core UAT vocabulary, \url{http://www.ivoa.net/rdf/uat} (see \ref{sect:VocabularyTerm}).

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: Free text description of the property or of the set made of the property and its associated properties.

reference.name: associatedProperties
reference.description: Open-ended collection of MANGO properties associated with the \texttt{MangoObject}. These relationships are typically used to associate physical properties with time stamps and/or quality factors.

objectType.name: Status
objectType.description: Property representing a status defined by a string (numerical values must be down-casted) that can only take on a defined number of values, each with its own description.

attribute.name: status
attribute.description: Actual value of the status

reference.name: allowedValues
reference.description: List of the allowed values for the status. Each value has its own free text description.

objectType.name: Label
objectType.description: Free text label seen as \texttt{MangoObject} property. The meaning of the label must match the property \texttt{semantics} attribute. This rule is not enforced by the model. For example, the Label property can be used to associate the sky object class of the \texttt{MangoObject} (e.g., Cataclysmic Variable) with the appropriate vocabulary.

attribute.name: text
attribute.description: Text of label property of the MANGO object.

objectType.name: Footprint

attribute.name: serialization
attribute.description: String serialization of the spatial extension of the \texttt{MangoObject}

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: Serialization mode of the spatial extension of the \texttt{MangoObject} \newline

reference.name: spaceSys
reference.description: Coordinate system that applies for the footprint

objectType.name: PhysicalProperty
objectType.description: Holder for any quantity that can be modeled by measure classes (Position, Time , Velocity, Polarization, ProperMotion, GenericMeasure) as defined in the \texttt{Astronomical Measurements Model}.

attribute.name: calibrationLevel
attribute.description: Calibration level of the property as defined in \url{http://www.ivoa.net/rdf/processing-level}

composition.name: measure
composition.description: Instance of \texttt{Astronomical Measurements Model} that holds the Property value(s).

objectType.name: Color
objectType.description: Property that describes a color of the \texttt{MangoObject}. The purpose of this property is to gather a color value with its error and the 2 related filters (high and low) The color can be given as a magnitude difference or a hardness ratio.

attribute.name: value
attribute.description: Color value.

attribute.name: error
attribute.description: Error on the \texttt{Color}.

composition.name: colorDef
composition.description: Reference to the physical definition of the color (can be either a difference of magnitudes or a hardness ratio).

objectType.name: ColorDef
objectType.description: Physical color definition giving the way a color is calculated (magnitude difference or hardness ratio) and the filters on which the color is based. In case of hardness ratio, the energy bands might be modeled as instances of \texttt{Phot:PhotometryFilter} with a square transfer function.

attribute.name: definition
attribute.description: Attribute giving the way the color is calculated (magnitude difference or hardness ratio).

reference.name: high
reference.description: Reference to the \texttt{Phot:PhotometryFilter} \citep{2022ivoa.spec.1101S} corresponding to the higher energy band of the color (lower mean wavelength).

reference.name: low
reference.description: Reference to the \texttt{Phot:PhotometryFilter} corresponding to the lower energy band for that color (larger mean wavelength).

objectType.name: StatusValues
objectType.description: Class holder for the list of the allowed values for the status.

composition.name: values
composition.description: List of the allowed values for the status; each value has its own textual description.

objectType.name: StatusValue
objectType.description: Value allowed for a status; contains the value with a free text description.

attribute.name: value
attribute.description: Allowed value for a \texttt{Status}

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: Free text description of the allowed value for a \texttt{Status}

objectType.name: EpochPosition

attribute.name: longitude
attribute.description: This parameter corresponds to the longitude as described by the \texttt{coords} data model: \textit{The longitude of the Point, as a Quantity with angular units} (see \texttt{coords:LonLatPoint.lon}). It is a clone of the \texttt{coords:LonLatPoint.lon} component of \texttt{meas:Position} but applied to the \texttt{mango:EpochPosition} context.

attribute.name: latitude
attribute.description: This parameter corresponds to the latitude as described by the \texttt{coords} data model: \textit{The latitude of the Point, as a Quantity with angular units} (see \texttt{coords:LonLatPoint.lat}). It is a clone of the \texttt{coords:LonLatPoint.lat} component of \texttt{meas:Position} but applied to the \texttt{mango:EpochPosition} context. It matches the description given by \texttt{coords} data model:

attribute.name: parallax
attribute.description: The measured parallax in the coordinate system of the \texttt{EpochPosition} instance.

attribute.name: radialVelocity
attribute.description: This parameter corresponds to the radial velocity as described by the \texttt{coords} data model: \textit{The measured Velocity along of the radial axis } (see \texttt{meas:Velocity.coord} in \cite{2022ivoa.spec.1004R}). It is a clone of the \texttt{coords:Coords.point} component of \texttt{meas:Velocity} but applied to the \texttt{mango:EpochPosition} context.

attribute.name: pmLongitude
attribute.description: This parameter corresponds to the proper motion longitude as described by the \texttt{coords} data model: \textit{Velocity along the longitude axis in angular distance per unit time} (see \texttt{meas:ProperMotion.coord}). It is a clone of the \texttt{coords:LonLatPoint.lon} component of \texttt{meas:ProperMotion} but applied to the \texttt{mango:EpochPosition} context.

attribute.name: pmLatitude
attribute.description: This parameter corresponds to the proper motion latitude as described by the \texttt{coords} data model: \textit{Velocity along the latitude axis in angular distance per unit time} (see \texttt{meas:ProperMotion.coord}). It is a clone of the \texttt{coords:LonLatPoint.lat} component of \texttt{meas:ProperMotion} but applied to the \texttt{mango:EpochPosition} context.

attribute.name: obsDate
attribute.description: Observation date expressed within the common time system if present. Figure \ref{datetime} shows up the hierarchy of the primitive types representing the observation dates.

attribute.name: pmCosLatApplied
attribute.description: It is common, though not universal, practice to quote longitudinal proper motion pre-multiplied by cos(latitude) so that the magnitude of the quantity is not affected by its longitudinal position. We do not constrain the value to one form or the other in this model. Instead, this flag enables providers to convey whether or not the factor has been applied (see \texttt{meas:ProperMotion.cosLat_applied})

composition.name: errors
composition.description: Reference to the combined errors of the \texttt{EpochPosition} components.

composition.name: correlations
composition.description: Reference to the correlations between the \texttt{EpochPosition} components.

reference.name: spaceSys
reference.description: System that applies to the space coordinates.

reference.name: timeSys
reference.description: System that applies to the time coordinates (the epoch).

objectType.name: EpochPositionErrors
objectType.description: Class holder for the errors of the EpochPosition attributes

attribute.name: parallax
attribute.description: Parallax error. This error is meant to be symmetrical in the current model version.

attribute.name: radialVelocity
attribute.description: Error in the radial velocity. This error is meant to be symmetrical in the current model version.

attribute.name: properMotion
attribute.description: Proper motion error; can be an \texttt{Ellipse} or a \texttt{Symmetrical2D}.

attribute.name: position
attribute.description: Position error; can be an \texttt{Ellipse} or a \texttt{Symmetrical2D}.

objectType.name: EpochPositionCorrelations
objectType.description: Class holder for the correlation coefficients between the \texttt{EpochPosition} components.

attribute.name: longitudeParallax
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the position longitude and the parallax

attribute.name: latitudeParallax
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the position latitude and the parallax

attribute.name: pmLongitudeParallax
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the proper motion longitude and the parallax

attribute.name: pmLatitudeParallax
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the proper motion latitude and the parallax

attribute.name: longitudeLatitude
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the position longitude and the position latitude

attribute.name: pmLongitudePmLatitude
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the proper motion longitude and the proper motion latitude

attribute.name: latitudePmLatitude
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the position latitude and the proper motion latitude

attribute.name: latitudePmLongitude
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the position latitude and the proper motion longitude

attribute.name: longitudePmLatitude
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the position longitude and the proper motion latitude

attribute.name: longitudePmLongitude
attribute.description: Correlation (or covariance) coefficient between the position longitude and the proper motion longitude

attribute.name: isCovariance
attribute.description: Boolean telling whether the correlations must be interpreted as covariance or as correlation coefficients.

objectType.name: Brightness
objectType.description: Observed brightness of the \texttt{MangoObject}. The purpose of this property is to gather a brightness value with its error and its photometric calibration The distinction between fluxes and magnitudes is made by the unit. The photometric calibration is modeled by the \texttt{Phot} data model (1.1).

attribute.name: value
attribute.description: Brightness value.

attribute.name: error
attribute.description: Error on the \texttt{Brightness}.

reference.name: photCal
reference.description: Photometric calibration that applies to the photometric property. It must be an instance of \texttt{photdm:PhotCal}.

package.name: error
package.description: The \texttt{error} package (fig \ref{fig:error}) groups the MANGO built-in error classes. Mango errors all have an attribute that specifies the confidence level.

dataType.name: PropertyError
dataType.description: Root (abstract) class of the errors that can be attached to a MANGO property.

attribute.name: confidenceLevel
attribute.description: Confidence level of the error. The confidence level must be in $[0, 1]$ (not enforced by the VO-DML schema).

attribute.name: distribution
attribute.description: Statistical distribution of the error. The Value can be a vocabulary URI (e.g. \url{https://www.ivoa.net/rdf/uat/2024-06-25/uat.html#poisson-distribution}).

attribute.name: sigma
attribute.description: Amplitude of the symmetrical error on a one-dimensional parameter

dataType.name: PErrorEllipse
dataType.description: Elliptic error for 2D parameters such as sky positions. Major axis and minor axis have their own units, which must be the same for both. This is not enforced by the model. The definition of the ellipse attribute is imported from \texttt{coords:Ellipse}.

attribute.name: semiMajorAxis
attribute.description: Half of the ellipse major axis

attribute.name: semiMinorAxis
attribute.description: Half of the ellipse minor axis

attribute.name: angle
attribute.description: In theory, this is the angle between the North Celestial Pole (NCP) and the major axis. This angle must be positive taking into account that angles are positive from North to the East. The angle has its own unit. In practice, the angle definition is this used by the mapped data set. It is usually the angle between the major axis and the north axis (negative along of the clockwise direction).

attribute.name: sigma1
attribute.description: Error on the first dimension (right ascension in case of sky coordinates)

attribute.name: sigma2
attribute.description: Error on the second dimension (declination in case of sky coordinates)

attribute.name: high
attribute.description: High limit for the asymmetrical error for 1D parameters

attribute.name: low
attribute.description: Low limit for the asymmetrical error for 1D parameters

package.name: origin
package.description: Package grouping together all the components needed to model the origin of the \texttt{MangoObject} (fig \ref{fig:origin}). The design of the package complies with the work of the DCP interest group (see \url{https://ivoa.net/documents/DataOrigin/index.html}).

objectType.name: Article
objectType.description: Reference article for the \texttt{MangoObject}, usually a bibcode or DOI

attribute.name: editor
attribute.description: Name of the article editor

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.description: Identifier of the reference article

objectType.name: DataOrigin
objectType.description: Class representing the description of the origin of the queried dataset.

attribute.name: ivoid
attribute.description: IVOID of the underlying data collection

attribute.name: reference_url
attribute.description: Dataset landing page

attribute.name: resource_version
attribute.description: Dataset version

attribute.name: creators
attribute.description: Person(s) mainly involved in the creation of the resource, generally the author(s).

attribute.name: cites
attribute.description: Identifier (IVOID, DOI or Bibcode) of a second Resource using relation of type \texttt{cites} (\url{https://www.ivoa.net/rdf/voresource/relationship_type/})

attribute.name: is_derived_from
attribute.description: Identifiers (IVOID, DOI or Bibcode) of a second resource using relation of type \texttt{is_derived_from} (\url{https://www.ivoa.net/rdf/voresource/relationship_type/})

attribute.name: original_date
attribute.description: Date of the original resource from which the MANGO object is derived

attribute.name: rights
attribute.description: Reference to the rights that apply to the data.

attribute.name: rights_uri
attribute.description: Licence URI. Following Registry practice, this should come from SPDX (\url{https://spdx.org/licenses}), though Creative Commons URLs (\url{https://creativecommons.org}) are also admitted.

reference.name: articles
reference.description: Reference to the articles from which the data originates.

objectType.name: QueryOrigin
objectType.description: Description of the query the \texttt{MangoObject} results from.

attribute.name: publisher
attribute.description: Data center that produced the \texttt{MangoObject}.

attribute.name: server_software
attribute.description: Version of the software that produced the \texttt{MangoObject} instance.

attribute.name: service_protocol
attribute.description: IVOID \citep{2007ivoa.spec.0314P} of the protocol through which the data was retrieved.

attribute.name: request
attribute.description: Full request URL including a query string. For the simple protocols,put the url-encoded form of the query parameters. For TAP queries, use the /sync UWS \citep{2016ivoa.spec.1024H} URL. The format is free for other request types.

attribute.name: request_date
attribute.description: Query execution date

attribute.name: query
attribute.description: Input query in a formal language such as ADQL \citep{2023ivoa.spec.1215M}

attribute.name: contact
attribute.description: Email or URL to contact the publisher

attribute.name: ivoid
attribute.description: IVOID of the service that provided the result set.

reference.name: dataOrigin
reference.description: Description of the origin of the data to which the query was applied.
